## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Refuting tumor-microbiome diagnostic utility](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/bacteria-and-cancer-latest-word)** — *In the Pipeline*
  * A commentary reviews recent literature on intra-tumoral bacteria, highlighting the 2024 retraction of a major 2023 *Nature* paper that claimed bacterial profiling could serve as a reliable cancer diagnostic.
  * While bacterial presence in tumor tissue is plausible due to altered vascularization and necrotic microenvironments, previous claims of specific diagnostic utility have been disproven by subsequent critical analyses.

* **[Serum brain-derived p-tau217 and SV2A reduce peripheral biomarker interference in AD](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.28.26359122)** — *medRxiv*
  * A multicenter study found that total blood p-tau217 levels can be confounded by muscle-derived p-tau217 (as observed in conditions like ALS), limiting diagnostic precision.
  * Assaying specific serum brain-derived p-tau217 and synaptic vesicle glycoprotein 2A (SV2A) reduced peripheral interference and significantly improved early diagnostic accuracy for Alzheimer's disease.

* **[Hypothalamic Notch signaling inhibition drives weight loss and circuit remodeling](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.29.740998)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Pharmacological inhibition of Notch ligands Jagged1 and Jagged2 (Jag1/2) in hypothalamic oligodendrocyte precursor cells (OPCs) induced rapid, reversible weight loss in animal models independent of caloric intake or systemic toxicity.
  * Jag1/2 blockade expanded a metabolically specialized GPR17 intermediate OPC population, triggering fasting-like transcriptional changes in AgRP neurons and driving peripheral catabolism.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **[Dual Phase 2 trials report safety and efficacy for GLP-1/amylin agonist zenagamtide](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42532080/)** — *The Lancet / PubMed*
  * Two Phase 2 multicenter, randomized, double-blind trials evaluated once-weekly subcutaneous and once-daily oral formulations of zenagamtide—a unimolecular GLP-1 and amylin receptor agonist—in adults with type 2 diabetes.
  * Both trial arms demonstrated dose-dependent glycemic control and weight reduction across evaluated cohorts.

* **[Biotech]** **[PDE10A inhibitor alofropodect shows efficacy in Phase 2 acute schizophrenia trial](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42533223/)** — *PubMed*
  * A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial assessed alofropodect (CPL'36), a phosphodiesterase-10A (PDE10A) inhibitor, in patients experiencing acute schizophrenia.
  * The trial established initial safety and preliminary symptom reduction compared to placebo.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Sanofi advances pan-KRAS inhibitor SAR449336 into Phase 1](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2082776232031146273)** — *X (@JacobPlieth)*
  * **[Sanofi]** highlighted the Phase 1 entry of SAR449336 (formerly BLU-924, out-licensed from Blueprint Medicines), an oral pan-KRAS inhibitor.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Merck briefly lists combination trial for MK-2010 and TROP2 ADC](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2082543852548768208)** — *X (@JacobPlieth)*
  * **[Merck & Co.]** briefly posted and subsequently removed a clinical trial listing evaluating its PD-1xVEGF bispecific antibody (MK-2010) in combination with its TROP2-targeting ADC sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT).

* **[Psilocybin-assisted therapy evaluated in veterans with treatment-resistant PTSD](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42533157/)** — *PubMed*
  * An open-label pilot trial evaluated psilocybin-assisted psychotherapy in military veterans suffering from severe, treatment-resistant post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).
  * Results established preliminary feasibility, safety, and positive clinical outcome trends.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Pfizer reports positive topline Phase 3 data for Litfulo in nonsegmental vitiligo](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2082780740698132872)** — *X (@BioStocks)*
  * **[Pfizer]** announced positive topline results from its Phase 3 trial of Litfulo (ritlecitinib), an oral dual TEC/JAK3 inhibitor, in patients with nonsegmental vitiligo.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Biotech]** **[FDA panel votes 10-3 in favor of Replimune’s melanoma therapy RP1](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/replimune-rp1-fda-vote-advisory-committee-melanoma-drug/826619/)** — *BioPharma Dive* / *X (@JacobPlieth)*
  * The FDA’s Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee voted 10-3 that efficacy data from the Phase 2 IGNYTE trial of RP1 (an oncolytic virus) in anti-PD-1-refractory melanoma are clinically meaningful.
  * FDA reviewers disputed Replimune's overall response rate (ORR) calculation (15.7% per agency methodology vs. 33.6% per company analysis due to differing patient population subsets).
  * The PDUFA target action date is August 2; if rejected, Replimune must await confirmatory Phase 3 data expected in late 2027.

* **[Biotech]** **[FDA advisory committee rejects Capricor’s Duchenne muscular dystrophy drug](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/07/30/fda-panel-nixes-duchenne-drug-ftc-sues-hims-and-hers/)** — *STAT News*
  * An FDA advisory panel concluded that clinical data for Capricor Therapeutics' deramiocel failed to establish substantial evidence of efficacy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD).

* **[Biotech]** **[Cytokinetics gains UK approval and positive NICE guidance for aficamten](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2082773605872460174)** — *X (@BioStocks)*
  * Cytokinetics announced that the UK MHRA granted marketing authorization for MYQORZO (aficamten) for symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM).
  * The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) issued positive draft guidance recommending reimbursement in England and Wales.

* **[Biotech]** **[Agios receives Priority Review for mitapivat in sickle cell disease](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2082801015485505687)** — *X (@BioStocks)*
  * **[Agios]** announced FDA Priority Review for its sNDA of Pyrukynd/Aqvesme (mitapivat) in sickle cell disease, with a PDUFA target date of November 1, 2026.
  * Q2 sales for mitapivat reached $41M, supported by 442 cumulative prescriptions written for its recent launch in thalassemia.

* **[Oral macrocyclic PCSK9 inhibitor receives FDA approval](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00123-4)** — *Nature Reviews Drug Discovery*
  * An update confirms FDA regulatory approval for a first-in-class oral macrocyclic PCSK9 inhibitor to treat hypercholesterolemia.

* **[FDA issues warning letter closeouts and updates FY 2027 user fee schedules](http://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/warning-letters/similasan-ag-658878-07292026)** — *U.S. FDA*
  * FDA issued warning letter closeouts for Similasan AG, Nubratori Inc., and MedisourceRx following verified cGMP and compounding corrective actions.
  * The agency published FY 2027 fee rates for PDUFA, GDUFA, and 503B outsourcing facilities, confirming a complete transition away from paper payments by late 2025.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **[J&J options in vivo CAR-T firm Sail Biomedicines for up to $2.6B](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/johnson-johnson-sail-option-acquire-in-vivo-car-t/826589/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * **[Johnson & Johnson]** entered a collaboration with Sail Biomedicines, paying $785M upfront (including $465M in equity) to advance preclinical program SAIL-0839 and Sail's in vivo immune-cell reprogramming platform.
  * J&J retains an exclusive option to acquire Sail for $2.58B.

* **[Biotech]** **[Alnylam stock tumbles 30% after lowering ATTR franchise revenue outlook](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/alnylam-earnings-stock-amvuttra-onpattro-sales-pfizer-ionis/826654/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * **[Alnylam]** cut its 2026 guidance for transthyretin amyloidosis drugs Amvuttra and Onpattro by $200M (to $4.2B–$4.5B), causing a ~$12B market capitalization loss.
  * The company noted that post-launch pent-up demand for Amvuttra has normalized amidst expanding competition from Pfizer (Vyndamax), BridgeBio (Attruby), and AstraZeneca/Ionis (eplontersen).

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Bristol Myers Squibb drops Phase 3 AR degrader gridegalutamide](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2082840576810954819)** — *X (@JacobPlieth)*
  * **[Bristol Myers Squibb]** discontinued gridegalutamide, an androgen receptor degrader that had previously transitioned directly from Phase 1 into Phase 3 trials.
  * Separately, BMS confirmed a target PDUFA date of March 11, 2027, to pursue regulatory review for Reblozyl despite the failure of its Phase 3 INDEPENDENCE trial.

* **[Biotech]** **[FTC sues Hims & Hers over health data privacy and billing claims](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/ftc-sues-hims-hers-alleged-privacy-violations-deceptive-billing/826612/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * The FTC filed a federal lawsuit against telehealth vendor Hims & Hers, alleging unlawful sharing of patient medical metrics with third-party platforms (Meta, Snap) via tracking pixels, as well as deceptive subscription charging routines.

* **[Biotech]** **[Abivax confirms plans for Obefazimod NDA submission by EOY](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2082975015838847361)** — *X (@BioStocks)*
  * **[Abivax]** reiterated plans to submit a U.S. NDA for oral obefazimod for moderate-to-severely active ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026.

* **[Commercial Q2 Financial Updates: Madrigal and Regeneron](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2082798079464386799)** — *X (@BioStocks)*
  * **[Madrigal Pharmaceuticals]** posted Q2 Rezdiffra net sales of $364M (+71% YoY), surpassing 49,000 active patients.
  * **[Regeneron]** reported total Q2 sales of $4.3B (+17% YoY); Eylea HD revenue reached $596M (+52%), offsetting a 45% decline in standard Eylea ($412M).

## Public Health & Policy

* **[FDA targets misleading DTC marketing of compounded GLP-1s](http://sciencebasedmedicine.org/the-fda-vs-compounding-pharmacies-glp-1-edition/)** — *Science-Based Medicine*
  * Analysis details three waves of FDA warning letters (over 110 total) targeting DTC telehealth companies for implying compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide are equivalent to FDA-approved branded products.
  * Regulators emphasize that 503A and 503B compounding exemptions do not grant generics-equivalent status or bypass safety oversight.

* **[Syphilis surge compounded by penicillin shortage and federal restrictions](https://www.statnews.com/2026/07/31/syphilis-drug-shortage-case-study-san-diego-patient-researcher-advocate/)** — *STAT News*
  * A case report on the San Diego-Tijuana border highlights rising syphilis transmission rates intersecting with chronic shortages of injectable penicillin and regulatory hurdles on border cross-surveillance research.

* **[Senate panel approves CDC and ASPR nominees](https://www.statnews.com/2026/07/30/senate-panel-backs-confirmation-health-nominees-schwartz-cdc-kaufman-aspr/)** — *STAT News*
  * The Senate HELP Committee approved the nominations of Dr. Erica Schwartz for CDC Director and Sean Kaufman for Assistant Secretary for Preparedness and Response (ASPR), sending both to the full Senate.

* **[Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak case-fatality reaches 40.4% in DRC](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.28.26359162)** — *medRxiv* / *STAT News*
  * The 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has generated 2,473 confirmed cases and 999 deaths (crude CFR of 40.4%).
  * Real-time modeling studies emphasize severe reporting delays and facility access barriers, while candidate vaccines remain several months away from deployment.

- Biology & Health
    - [Glucosamine: More Death, More Alzheimer’s Disease - New Study!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MqZku0O93k8) -- Physionic
        - A study published in Nature Metabolism (Hawkinson et al.) identifies hyperglycosylation as a key metabolic driver of Alzheimer’s disease.
        - Prospective cohort and Mendelian randomization studies evaluate the potential associations between regular glucosamine supplementation and incident dementia risk.
        - Research examines how baseline metabolic conditions—such as type 2 diabetes—and genetic risk factors like APOE genotypes influence the health outcomes associated with habitual glucosamine use.
    - [The Real Reason Blockchain Didn’t Go Mainstream](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/iXz50GrxEtM) -- Health2Tech
        - Speaker Chris Moose discusses why blockchain technology has struggled to achieve mainstream consumer adoption.
        - The video asserts that blockchain should serve as an invisible back-end infrastructure rather than being marketed as the primary feature of a product.
        - Successful product strategy in digital health and healthtech requires emphasizing user utility over underlying Web3 or crypto implementations.
- Pure Science
    - [The World's Heaviest Weight](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3HQkVfZ4DNY) -- Veritasium
        - High-capacity force transducers are accurately calibrated using the world's largest deadweight machine, capable of generating 1,000,000 pounds of force.
        - Precise measurement and calibration of large mechanical forces are critical to verifying structural integrity and performance in extreme engineering applications.
        - This calibration standard ensures safety and operational reliability for aircraft airframes, jet engine thrust outputs, and space launch rockets.
